items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: That was inspired by playing with Paquito

ctx.x: “Aha.” I like that title by the way.
Yeah. I wrote that a while ago. That was inspired by playing with Paquito and that’s who I wrote it for. That’s something he used to say, “Aha!” You know? © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
